statement: Linux hid-nintendo open initialization attempts USB 0x80 handshake, baudrate 0x03, second handshake and no-timeout 0x04 (when USB handshake succeeds); then 0x02 device info, user-magic and factory/user stick SPI 0x10 reads, IMU SPI calibration, IMU enable 0x40 ACK, set 0x30 report mode ACK, and vibration enable 0x48 ACK. Failures on key enable/mode steps block regular Pro init.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: hid-nintendo.c 2518-2637; 1049-1077, 1080-1215, 1273-1377. This is observed source order, not a measured retail response trace; licensed Pro special-case differs.
